conclusion.ordinary_text_policy: Durable text pending/attempting/failed ledger with intentional marked at-least-once replay. Crash after send before ACK causes attempting row to be claimed then adapter.send again. This differs from strict R02 uncertain-reconcile-without-resend oracle if the case includes plain text.
conclusion.ordinary_managed_file_policy: Different real consumer: run_plugin_delivery ordinary_documents.v1 plus native immutable journals; UNKNOWN durably precedes byte send and exact receipt gates DELIVERED. Same original route/selection is fenced on replay using immutable history, including when current mutable row is missing. No fallback file or answer resend after handled UNKNOWN.
conclusion.file_reconciliation: The localized installed consumer enforces reconciliation-required by refusal, not an implemented remote receipt lookup or transition repairing UNKNOWN. It proves no-resend design statically; successful reconciliation still needs an admitted separate operation and observations.
conclusion.proven_defect: No forced localized patch justified. Text behavior is executed deliberate at-least-once policy, not just a contradictory comment; whether this constitutes required product change depends on R02 chosen scope. No runtime reproduction performed.
